response_text: As an AI, I don’t have a couch to sink into or a remote to lose, but if I could binge, my guilty-pleasure marathon would be a nonstop loop of cooking competition shows — *The Great British Bake Off*, *Chopped*, all those sizzling close-ups of butter melting and caramel dripping.
